messages:
amy: Quick note — onboarding sample shows weird truncated streams when auth refresh occurs.

louis: Saw that too. Often missing the final data: [DONE] line.

jen: Probable cause: SDK calls AbortController.abort() during refresh which can leave partial bytes unread.

amy: Proposed fix: flush TextDecoder on close and emit a __SSE_PARTIAL__ event so apps can decide to resume.

louis: Also add tests in tests/streaming that simulate mid-event abort. Small harness should be fine.

devex-bot: Issue created: SDK-2499 — streaming partial-on-abort handling.
